mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (id, workspace_id, req_id, title, precondition, steps, latest_status, latest_note, latest_by, latest_by_user_id, latest_at, latest_bug_task_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{title}, #{precondition}, #{steps}, #{latestStatus}, #{latestNote}, #{latestBy}, #{latestByUserId}, #{latestAt}, #{latestBugTaskId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET latest_status = #{status}, latest_note = #{note}, latest_by = #{by}, latest_by_user_id = #{byUserId}, latest_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.title, c.precondition, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT latest_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND latest_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY latest_status
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_case WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
